failed_attempt_summary.1_to_7: Launcher path, battery-unit, shell-output, MAVLink-direct ACK, daemon-lockstep, malformed-JSON, and direct-send integration failures were preserved before a physical command reached the intended PX4 handler.
failed_attempt_summary.8_to_13: Raw GCS COMMAND_LONG variants used split or temporary UDP source ports and did not establish a valid bidirectional GCS command session; runner cleanup remained exact.
failed_attempt_summary.14: MAVSDK Failure plus independent GCS STATUSTEXT monitoring timed out; no PX4 failure-handler evidence was emitted.
failed_attempt_summary.15: The same path exposed MAVSDK FailureError TIMEOUT for both GPS off and GPS ok.
failed_attempt_summary.16: A same-socket GCS COMMAND_LONG reached PX4 vehicle_command twice, but gz_x500 produced no command 420 acknowledgment because gz_bridge does not implement the SimulatorMavlink failure handler.
failed_attempt_summary.17: The supported gz_bridge SIM_GPS_USED path first completed in the dirty working tree; it was not treated as exact-commit frozen evidence.
failed_attempt_summary.18: The exact-commit SIM_GPS_USED plus gps_info path completed and became the authoritative frozen run.

attempt_16.root_cause: PX4 gz_x500 starts gz_bridge, whose source consumes SIM_GPS_USED but does not subscribe to MAV_CMD_INJECT_FAILURE; the SimulatorMavlink failure handler is absent from this runtime.

authoritative_resolution.mechanism: PX4 gz_bridge SIM_GPS_USED with exact parameter readback and MAVSDK gps_info telemetry
